'''Rrooogli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Rroorgli co-run the [[Comet Broom Service]] along with the male Wookiee [[Mronk]]. The service monitored and destroyed dangerous comets around the [[Cularin comet cloud]] and was based on [[Artom Station]], where the two Wookiees had offices. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rroorgli and Mronk were hired by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]], who was in disguise as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]], to initiate the [[Cometary Water Reclamation Project]], a project that was suposedly to sent a comet into the atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].

After the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'' was damaged because of faulty data supplied by the Comet Broom Service, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] were hired to investigate and they visited Rroorgli and Mronk on Artom Station. The Wookiees denied any wrong doing and gave the heroes a copy of some of the data that they had supplied to [[Cularin SpaceNav]]. A short time later, Rroorgli and Mronk were murdered by Ezzar, to help cover up the Cometary Project.
